mapper.sql: id, contract_code, org_id, verification_status, client_code, client_name, verification_date, financial_expense_amount, provision_reversal_amount, provision_reversal_year, tax_verification_date, tax_verification_amount, process_instance_id, process_status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select:
with a as ( select t1.contract_code, t1.org_id, t1.verification_status, t1.client_code, t1.client_name, t1.verification_date, eco.tax_verification_date, -- 税务核销日期 eco.tax_verification_amount, -- 税务核销金额 t1.financial_expense_amount, eco.provision_reversal_amount, t1.provision_reversal_year, eco.bad_debt_write_off_balance from ( select evd.contract_code, evd.org_id, ev.verification_status, evd.client_code, evd.client_name, ev.account_date as verification_date, evd.financial_expense_amount, 0 as depreciation_loss_amount, to_char(now(), 'yyyy') provision_reversal_year from eg_verification_details evd inner join eg_verification ev on evd.verification_id = ev.id where 1 = 1 and evd.del_flag = '0' and ev.del_flag = '0' and ev.process_status in ('2', '3', '4') and to_char(ev.account_date, 'yyyymm')::int = #{param.periodCode} union all select eid.contract_code, eid.org_id, eid.financial_contract_status verification_status, eid.client_code, eid.client_name, eid.inbound_date::varchar::timestamp verification_date, eid.provision_for_impairment financial_expense_amount, -- 财务核销敞口金额 0 as depreciation_loss_amount, -- 拨备转回金额 to_char(now(), 'yyyy') provision_reversal_year from eg_recycling_equipment_in_detail eid inner join eg_recycling_equipment_in erei on eid.inbound_date = erei.inbound_date and eid.org_id = erei.org_id and eid.recycle_id = erei.id where 1 = 1 and eid.del_flag = '0' and erei.del_flag = '0' and erei.process_status in ('2', '3', '4') and to_char(eid.inbound_date::varchar::timestamp, 'yyyymm')::int = #{param.periodCode} ) t1 left join eg_charge_off eco on t1.org_id = eco.org_id and t1.contract_code = eco.contract_code and eco.verification_status = t1.verification_status and eco.verification_date = t1.verification_date and eco.process_status in ('2', '3', '4') ), eco as ( select distinct contract_code , org_id ,verification_status ,verification_date, tax_verification_date, tax_verification_amount from eg_charge_off where tax_verification_date is not null and tax_verification_amount is not null and process_status in ('2', '3', '4') ), cr as ( select a.* from a union all select b.contract_code, b.org_id, b.verification_status, b.client_code, b.client_name, b.verification_date, b.tax_verification_date, b.tax_verification_amount, b.financial_expense_amount, b.provision_reversal_amount, b.provision_reversal_year, b.bad_debt_write_off_balance from eg_charge_off b where 1 = 1 and b.process_status in ('2', '3', '4') and to_char(b.verification_date, 'yyyymm')::int = #{param.periodCode} and not exists ( select 1 from a where a.contract_code = b.contract_code and a.org_id = b.org_id and a.verification_date = b.verification_date and a.provision_reversal_year = b.provision_reversal_year) union all select c.contract_code, c.org_id, c.verification_status, c.client_code, c.client_name, c.verification_date, eco.tax_verification_date, eco.tax_verification_amount, c.financial_expense_amount, c.provision_reversal_amount, c.provision_reversal_year, c.bad_debt_write_off_balance from eg_charge_off_summary_report c left join eco on c.contract_code = eco.contract_code and c.org_id = eco.org_id and c.provision_reversal_year = to_char(eco.verification_date, 'yyyy') and c.verification_date = eco.verification_date and c.verification_status = eco.verification_status where 1 = 1 and c.period_code = #{param.lastPeriodCode} and c.del_flag = '0' and not exists ( select 1 from a where a.contract_code = c.contract_code and a.org_id = c.org_id and a.verification_date = c.verification_date and a.provision_reversal_year = c.provision_reversal_year) ), ta as ( select cr.contract_code, cr.org_id, cr.verification_date, cr.verification_status, cr.tax_verification_date, cr.tax_verification_amount from cr where cr.tax_verification_date is not null and cr.tax_verification_amount is not null group by cr.contract_code, cr.org_id, cr.verification_date, cr.verification_status, cr.tax_verification_date, cr.tax_verification_amount ), cb as ( select case when cr.verification_status = '财务入库' then sum(coalesce(ecb.depreciation_loss_amount, 0)) else sum(coalesce(ecb.depreciation_loss_reverse_amount, 0)) end as depreciation_loss_reverse_amount, ecb.contract_code , ecb.org_id, cr.verification_status from eg_contract_balance ecb left join cr on cr.contract_code = ecb.contract_code and cr.org_id = ecb.org_id and cr.provision_reversal_year=substring(cast(ecb.period_code as text), 1, 4) where 1 = 1 and ecb.period_code = #{param.periodCode} and ecb.del_flag = '0' and ecb.scene_code in ('ZLSK','KJFP','RKCZ','RKSH','CWCK') group by ecb.contract_code , ecb.org_id, cr.verification_status ), dr as ( select contract_code , org_id, verification_date, provision_reversal_year, provision_reversal_amount, verification_status from ( select contract_code , org_id, verification_date, provision_reversal_year, provision_reversal_amount, verification_status, row_number() over (PARTITION BY contract_code ,org_id, verification_status order by verification_date desc, provision_reversal_year desc) as rn from cr ) m where m.rn = 1 ), re as ( select cr.contract_code, cr.org_id, cr.verification_status, cr.client_code, cr.client_name, cr.verification_date, cr.provision_reversal_year, cr.tax_verification_date, cr.tax_verification_amount, case when dr.contract_code is null then coalesce(cr.provision_reversal_amount, 0) else (coalesce(dr.provision_reversal_amount, 0)- coalesce(cb.depreciation_loss_reverse_amount, 0)) end as provision_reversal_amount, coalesce(cr.financial_expense_amount, 0) as financial_expense_amount -- (coalesce(c.financial_expense_amount, 0)- ((coalesce(sr.provision_reversal_amount, 0)-cb.depreciation_loss_reverse_amount))) as bad_debt_write_off_balance from cr left join dr on cr.contract_code = dr.contract_code and cr.org_id = dr.org_id and cr.verification_date = dr.verification_date and cr.provision_reversal_year = dr.provision_reversal_year and cr.verification_status = dr.verification_status left join cb on cb.contract_code = cr.contract_code and cb.org_id = cr.org_id and cr.verification_status = cb.verification_status ), re1 as ( select re.contract_code, re.org_id, re.verification_status, re.client_code, re.client_name, re.verification_date, sum(re.provision_reversal_amount) provision_reversal_amount, re.financial_expense_amount, coalesce(re.financial_expense_amount, 0) - sum(re.provision_reversal_amount) as bad_debt_write_off_balance from re group by re.contract_code, re.org_id, re.verification_status, re.client_code, re.client_name, re.verification_date, re.financial_expense_amount ) select re1.contract_code, re1.org_id, re1.verification_status, re1.client_code, re1.client_name, re1.verification_date, ta.tax_verification_date, ta.tax_verification_amount, re1.provision_reversal_amount, re1.financial_expense_amount, re1.bad_debt_write_off_balance from re1 left join ta on re1.contract_code = ta.contract_code and re1.org_id = ta.org_id and re1.verification_date = ta.verification_date and re1.verification_status = ta.verification_status where 1 = 1
and re1.contract_code like concat('%', #{param.contractCode}::text, '%')
and re1.client_name like concat('%', #{param.clientName}::text, '%')
and re1.org_id = #{param.orgId}
and re1.org_id in
#{item}
and re1.verification_status in
#{item}
and to_char(re1.verification_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') >= to_char(to_date(#{param.startVerificationDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')
and to_char(re1.verification_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= to_char(to_date(#{param.endVerificationDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')
and to_char(ta.tax_verification_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') >= to_char(to_date(#{param.startTaxVerificationDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')
and to_char(ta.tax_verification_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= to_char(to_date(#{param.endTaxVerificationDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')

with a as ( select t1.contract_code, t1.org_id, t1.verification_status, t1.client_code, t1.client_name, t1.verification_date, eco.tax_verification_date, eco.tax_verification_amount, t1.financial_expense_amount, eco.provision_reversal_amount, t1.provision_reversal_year, eco.bad_debt_write_off_balance from ( select evd.contract_code, evd.org_id, ev.verification_status, evd.client_code, evd.client_name, ev.account_date as verification_date, evd.financial_expense_amount, 0 as depreciation_loss_amount, to_char(now(), 'yyyy') provision_reversal_year from eg_verification_details evd inner join eg_verification ev on evd.verification_id = ev.id where 1 = 1 and evd.del_flag = '0' and ev.del_flag = '0' and ev.process_status in ('2', '3', '4') and evd.financial_contract_status != '非亏损结清' and to_char(ev.account_date, 'yyyymm')::int = #{param.periodCode} union all select eid.contract_code, eid.org_id, eid.financial_contract_status verification_status, eid.client_code, eid.client_name, eid.inbound_date::varchar::timestamp verification_date, eid.provision_for_impairment financial_expense_amount, -- 财务核销敞口金额 0 as depreciation_loss_amount, -- 拨备转回金额 to_char(now(), 'yyyy') provision_reversal_year from eg_recycling_equipment_in_detail eid inner join eg_recycling_equipment_in erei on eid.inbound_date = erei.inbound_date and eid.org_id = erei.org_id and eid.recycle_id = erei.id where 1 = 1 and eid.del_flag = '0' and erei.del_flag = '0' and erei.process_status in ('2', '3', '4') and to_char(eid.inbound_date::varchar::timestamp, 'yyyymm')::int = #{param.periodCode} ) t1 left join eg_charge_off eco on t1.org_id = eco.org_id and t1.contract_code = eco.contract_code and eco.verification_status = t1.verification_status and eco.verification_date = t1.verification_date and eco.process_status in ('2', '3', '4') ), eco as ( select distinct contract_code , org_id ,verification_status ,verification_date, tax_verification_date, tax_verification_amount from eg_charge_off where tax_verification_date is not null and tax_verification_amount is not null and process_status in ('2', '3', '4') ), cr as ( select a.* from a union all select b.contract_code, b.org_id, b.verification_status, b.client_code, b.client_name, b.verification_date, b.tax_verification_date, b.tax_verification_amount, b.financial_expense_amount, b.provision_reversal_amount, b.provision_reversal_year, b.bad_debt_write_off_balance from eg_charge_off b where 1 = 1 and b.process_status in ('2', '3', '4') and to_char(b.verification_date, 'yyyymm')::int = #{param.periodCode} and not exists ( select 1 from a where a.contract_code = b.contract_code and a.org_id = b.org_id and a.verification_date = b.verification_date and a.provision_reversal_year = b.provision_reversal_year) union all select c.contract_code, c.org_id, c.verification_status, c.client_code, c.client_name, c.verification_date, eco.tax_verification_date, eco.tax_verification_amount, c.financial_expense_amount, c.provision_reversal_amount, c.provision_reversal_year, c.bad_debt_write_off_balance from eg_charge_off_summary_report c left join eco on c.contract_code = eco.contract_code and c.org_id = eco.org_id and c.provision_reversal_year = to_char(eco.verification_date, 'yyyy') and c.verification_date = eco.verification_date and c.verification_status = eco.verification_status where 1 = 1 and c.period_code = #{param.lastPeriodCode} and c.del_flag = '0' and not exists ( select 1 from a where a.contract_code = c.contract_code and a.org_id = c.org_id and a.verification_date = c.verification_date and a.provision_reversal_year = c.provision_reversal_year) ), cb as ( select case when cr.verification_status = '财务入库' then sum(coalesce(ecb.depreciation_loss_amount, 0)) else sum(coalesce(ecb.depreciation_loss_reverse_amount, 0)) end as depreciation_loss_reverse_amount, ecb.contract_code , ecb.org_id, cr.verification_status, cr.verification_date from eg_contract_balance ecb left join cr on cr.contract_code = ecb.contract_code and cr.org_id = ecb.org_id and cr.provision_reversal_year=substring(cast(ecb.period_code as text), 1, 4) where 1 = 1 and ecb.period_code = #{param.periodCode} and ecb.del_flag = '0' and ecb.scene_code in ('ZLSK','KJFP','RKCZ','RKSH','CWCK') group by ecb.contract_code , ecb.org_id, cr.verification_status, cr.verification_date ), dr as ( select contract_code , org_id, verification_date, provision_reversal_year, provision_reversal_amount, verification_status from ( select contract_code , org_id, verification_date, provision_reversal_year, provision_reversal_amount, verification_status, row_number() over (PARTITION BY contract_code ,org_id, verification_status order by verification_date desc, provision_reversal_year desc) as rn from cr ) m where m.rn = 1 ), bd as ( select contract_code , org_id, verification_date, verification_status, sum(coalesce (provision_reversal_amount, 0)) as provision_reversal_amount from cr group by contract_code , org_id, verification_date, verification_status ) insert into eg_charge_off_summary_report ( period_code, contract_code, org_id, verification_status, client_code, client_name, verification_date, financial_expense_amount, provision_reversal_amount, provision_reversal_year, tax_verification_date, tax_verification_amount, bad_debt_write_off_balance, del_flag, create_time ) select ${param.periodCode} as period_code, cr.contract_code, cr.org_id, cr.verification_status, cr.client_code, cr.client_name, cr.verification_date, coalesce(cr.financial_expense_amount, 0) as financial_expense_amount, case when dr.contract_code is null then coalesce(cr.provision_reversal_amount, 0) else (coalesce(dr.provision_reversal_amount, 0)-coalesce (cb.depreciation_loss_reverse_amount, 0)) end as provision_reversal_amount, cr.provision_reversal_year, cr.tax_verification_date, cr.tax_verification_amount, (coalesce(cr.financial_expense_amount, 0) - coalesce(bd.provision_reversal_amount, 0) + coalesce (cb.depreciation_loss_reverse_amount, 0)) as bad_debt_write_off_balance, '0' as del_flag, now() from cr left join dr on cr.contract_code = dr.contract_code and cr.org_id = dr.org_id and cr.verification_date = dr.verification_date and cr.provision_reversal_year = dr.provision_reversal_year and cr.verification_status = dr.verification_status left join bd on bd.contract_code = cr.contract_code and bd.org_id = cr.org_id and bd.verification_date = cr.verification_date and bd.verification_status = cr.verification_status left join cb on cb.contract_code = cr.contract_code and cb.org_id = cr.org_id and cr.verification_status = cb.verification_status and cb.verification_date = cr.verification_date
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM eg_contract_balance_month t WHERE t.period_code=#{periodCode});

select ${param.periodCode} as period_code, sr.contract_code, sr.org_id, oc.org_name, sr.verification_status, sr.client_code, sr.client_name, sr.verification_date, sr.financial_expense_amount, sr.provision_reversal_amount, sr.provision_reversal_year, sr.tax_verification_date, sr.tax_verification_amount, sr.bad_debt_write_off_balance, '0' as del_flag from eg_charge_off_summary_report sr left join eg_org_company oc on oc.org_id = sr.org_id and oc.del_flag ='0' where sr.period_code = #{param.periodCode} and sr.del_flag = '0'
and sr.contract_code = #{param.contractCode}
and sr.org_id in
#{item}
and sr.verification_status in
#{item}
and sr.client_name like concat('%', #{param.clientName}::text, '%')
and to_char(sr.verification_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') >= to_char(to_date(#{param.startVerificationDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')
and to_char(sr.verification_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= to_char(to_date(#{param.endVerificationDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')
and to_char(sr.tax_verification_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') >= to_char(to_date(#{param.startTaxVerificationDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')
and to_char(sr.tax_verification_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= to_char(to_date(#{param.endTaxVerificationDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')
order by sr.verification_date
